capabilities: connect a vault to a cloud provider via authentication
select a remote provider folder as the sync target
upload local vault files to the remote vault
download provider files missing from the vault
resolve name conflicts by most recent modification timestamp
extras: README includes disclosures that synced remote files will be editable and deletable in the vault; currently only Dropbox is supported.
problem: Obsidian stores notes locally with no built-in way to sync a vault with an external cloud storage provider like Dropbox.

relations.evidence: This plugin interacts with dropbox via the dropbox javascript sdk.

summary: Sync plugin that links an Obsidian vault to a cloud storage provider (currently Dropbox) and copies files between them on desktop and mobile.
